why: The lookahead's own weights, searched with the lookahead playing every candidate (--kind lookahead), now that a search may run six hours (#280). The lookahead plays best on the built-in weights: 0.933 against Greedy and 0.933 against search-23 on 60 unseen seeds, where the set a local search found on 20 seeds lost 0.133 against Greedy (journal, 2026-10-04). So this one starts from the built-in weights, against Greedy and search-23, the two the lookahead was measured against, on learning/experiments/lookahead-seeds.json: the first 30 benchmark seeds, because the hold-out replays both agents on as many unseen seeds as the file holds, and on 200 it alone would take over three hours with the lookahead. 3 rounds of 5, seed 0, about 4.5 hours by the local rate of 15 seconds a seed against one opponent. No check opponent, for the same budget. What would make it a rung: a set that beats the built-in weights on the unseen seeds against both, and holds when replayed on 60 more.
